exclusions.name: Clad the Swarm (inactive legacy control)
exclusions.reason: HTML-only legacy control: cladSwarm is undefined and current runtime never assigns Cold status 4, so no gameplay behavior is required.

exclusions.name: Inactive Battles report, territory loss, and legacy combat formulas
exclusions.reason: All behaviors are inside commented code/UI. Live combat does not apply territory loss, large legacy battle reports, probeCombat^1.7 offense, or naming-based offense doubling.

exclusions.name: Commented reset, persistence, prestige, and cheat controls
exclusions.reason: The controls are commented out, are not legitimate progression paths, and must not be exposed or used to satisfy gameplay acceptance.

exclusions.name: Browser save omissions and reload-time battle cancellation
exclusions.reason: The missing probeHarv field, reload-time deletion of the restored battle record without serialized ships/grid, and browser-storage behavior are non-authoritative persistence defects, not game mechanics. Battle-name counters are saved/restored. Product requirements use coherent population and battle state rather than reproduce them.

exclusions.name: Browser ending/audio restoration and repeatable-project hot fixes
exclusions.reason: Audio timing, stale overlays, browser reload behavior, and uses repair are implementation artifacts. Ending state mechanics and prestige-versus-run resets are owned by the active END/PROG capabilities.
